page.title: Your account is ready
page.intro: Stress Index for people who measure themselves lives in the app on your phone. There is no area for you on the website: measurements, your trend over time and the link with your professional are all in the app.
page.step1Body: Install it on your smartphone from the store.
page.step2Body: Use your email and the password you chose.
page.step3Body: Connect the sensor and follow the app's instructions. Your professional sees the measurements you share with them.

stores.iphoneAsk: On iPhone, ask your professional for the access link.
